purpose: Real-data scenario transfer of asymmetric FAR-Cal under permanent feedback loss
evaluation_cells: Sensors named by the active C4 event from event start through 12 bins after event end.
scalable_variant: Causal age/context-weighted signed residuals from the sensor and its two-neighbor group, capped at 256 records per sensor, with the locked stale-feedback rule.
inference: Three model seeds are averaged within each fault seed, followed by a 24-hour moving-block bootstrap stratified across three fault seeds.
superiority_rule: Both comparator-minus-candidate 95% lower bounds must exceed zero and aggregate coverage must be at least 0.88.
